source: src/generators/economy/foodBalance.js :: deriveFoodBalanceAnalysis (issues/warnings lines, suggestedFixes, channel labels, magic notes)

pool.notes: Analysis lines + suggestedFixes (key suffix ::fix.N). plotHooks are NOT annotated (hook seat). The deficit branches read the canonical food record (deficitPercent vs FOOD_SECURITY_CUTS) — close to the food-band reader, declared. "grain" is spoken as the staple in every dependency line: unhomed: staple = grain (a fish/herd place is told of grain). Crisis-scoped: "Agricultural Surplus", "manageable", "becomes a famine"/"famine risk" carry calm-type claims. Stress notes: foodBalance.deriveFoodBalanceAnalysis.stressNotes.json.
